name: Ring of Spell Precision
body:
Price 4,000 gp; Aura moderate divination; CL 6; Weight –

This simple band has a colored glass gem on it. When targeting a creature, it emits a beam that helps the spellcaster aim their spell attack. If a target is within 60 feet, the wearer gains a +2 bonus on their ranged touch attack rolls.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 2,000 gp; Feats Forge Ring; Spells true strike
